narrative:
Operating expenses of about EUR 159M (12.5% of revenue) are planned by cost centre, account and country: patient admissions, marketing and payer contracting; clinic administration and patient accounting; IT, digital therapy and data; quality, medical board and compliance; and finance, HR, procurement and corporate.

About 60% of OpEx is people cost driven from the workforce plan. The biggest non-people levers are the carve-out transitional services, which fall away as standalone functions go live, and the hospital information system and licences, consolidated onto one data platform.

signals.title: Carve-out completed — PAI Partners 67%, Fresenius 33%
signals.excerpt: The former Vamed rehabilitation business operates as VITREA, owned 67% by PAI Partners and 33% by Fresenius; standalone functions replace transitional services.

signals.title: High double-digit EUR million investment programme
signals.excerpt: Investment in outpatient rehab, clinic modernisation and digital therapy.
